title: Explicit estimates of the weighted sum $S(x)=\sum_{n \leq x} (-2)^{Ω(n)} \log\bigl(\frac{x}{n}\bigr).$
summary: We study the oscillatory arithmetic function $(-2)^{Ω(n)}$, where $Ω(n)$ counts the number of prime factors of $n$, with multiplicity. Sun conjectured a bound on its partial sums $W(x) = \sum_{n \leq x}^{} (-2)^{Ω(n)}$ as $|W(x)| < x$ for all $x \geq 3078$. In this direction, we obtain new bounds for its logarithmically weighted average \begin{equation*} S(x)=\sum_{n \leq x} (-2)^{Ω(n)} \log\biggl(\frac{x}{n}\biggr). \end{equation*} Using complex-analytic methods such as the log-weighted Perron's formula, we computed the bound $|S(x)| \leq 1.6x$
